column7: POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/machine-identities/{machineId}/tokens returned 500 instead of 403 for a legitimate MACH-001 privilege-ceiling refusal (ErrMachinePrivilegeCeilingDenied), because the handler's status-code switch classified errors by message substring and none of its arms matched the sentinel's wrapped prose. Found while fixing authzdiff known-03/D3 in the same handler. Fixed by adding errors.Is(err, core.ErrPermissionDenied) -> 403 before the switch's default branch.
